headword: {中肉中背|ちゅうにくちゅうせい}
reading: ちゅうにくちゅうせい
gloss: medium build; average height and weight

definitions.gloss: medium build; average height and weight
definitions.explanation: A person of average physique, neither particularly tall nor short, neither thin nor heavy.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}は{中肉中背|ちゅうにくちゅうせい}の{男|おとこ}だった。
examples.english: The suspect was a man of average build.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{中肉中背|ちゅうにくちゅうせい}で、{特徴|とくちょう}のない{体型|たいけい}だ。
examples.english: He has an average build with no distinguishing physical features.

examples.japanese: {目撃者|もくげきしゃ}の{証言|しょうげん}によると、{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}は{中肉中背|ちゅうにくちゅうせい}で{黒|くろ}い{帽子|ぼうし}をかぶっていたという。
examples.english: According to the witness's testimony, the suspect was of medium build and wearing a black hat.

notes:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) describing someone whose body type is unremarkable — average in both weight ({中肉|ちゅうにく}) and height ({中背|ちゅうぜい}). The word {背|せい} here refers to stature or height.

This expression is extremely common in physical descriptions, especially in police reports, news accounts of wanted persons, and character descriptions in fiction. It conveys the idea that the person would not stand out in a crowd.

USAGE:
Typically used as a noun modifying another noun (の construction) or in predicate position with だ/です. Often appears in descriptions where physical appearance matters but nothing distinctive can be identified.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中肉中背|ちゅうにくちゅうせい}の{男性|だんせい}: a man of medium build
- {中肉中背|ちゅうにくちゅうせい}の{体型|たいけい}: an average body type
- {中肉中背|ちゅうにくちゅうせい}で{目立|めだ}たない: average build and inconspicuous

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {普通|ふつう}の{体型|たいけい}: normal body type (everyday expression, less precise)
- {小柄|こがら}: small build
- {大柄|おおがら}: large build
